caption: The drawing depicts a round, metallic object that appears to be a spool or reel with a raised center and a circular groove around the middle. The outer surface is perforated with evenly spaced holes and features a detailed, shaded texture indicating a metallic or possibly ceramic material. A curved, wire-like component is attached at the top, looping twice around the central hub and secured at two points on the spool’s surface. The drawing is executed in grayscale pencil on an off-white background, with careful shading to suggest depth and the reflective quality of the object. The artist's name, "EDITH MILLER," is written in small letters to the lower right of the object. The composition is centered on the page, with the object occupying the majority of the image space.
title: Lantern
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
